chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub narrated from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Abdullah ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Aban ibn Uthman, from al-Fadl ibn Abd al-Malik, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"Indeed, breastfeeding before the two years, before weaning [establishes kinship]."
ai.seo_question: What is the age limit for breastfeeding to establish kinship in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Tusi's *Tahdhib* clarifies the temporal boundary for establishing kinship through breastfeeding (radha'), specifying that the act must occur before the child reaches two years of age and prior to weaning. In Shia jurisprudence, this criterion is essential for determining the mahram status that prohibits marriage, distinguishing it from post-weaning nursing which does not create the same legal bond.
